name: natural-load
purpose: iter-463 devtools item 6: the RETAIL front end's own LOAD path from a save seed, NO mod (-Gates SR_MODS=0,SR_CONTENT_DIR=<content root>; requires.contentSeed makes sr_drive refuse without one). title -> START -> the natural LOAD A GAME? popup (LoadCreate: [Start New Game, Load Game], default 0; CUSTOM_FRONTEND.md 2.1 rows 6-9) -> DOWN, A = button 1 LOAD GAME -> sub_822B32B8 calls AS ScrPressStart.ShowSlotSelector(1) (the slot picker's content enumeration: [XAM_CONTENT] XamContentCreateEnumerator dev=1 lr=82149738) -> SaveLoadSlots MODE_LOAD fills its 3 slots (an in-use slot's save image: [APT_REQ] artassets/SaveImages/SaveImage_N); in LOAD mode an empty slot is DISABLED and the focus lands on the FIRST IN-USE slot (SaveLoadSlots.as 0x0F3D-0x0FA9: isEnabled = IsSlotInUse || mode==SAVE; isSelected = isEnabled && !foundSelected) -> A = SaveLoadAdapter.LoadTask(slot) -> sub_822B4ED8 applies the slot (AptDisplayListBuildTable_sub_8218E4A0) and calls LoadComplete(true) synchronously -> ScrPressStart.LoadComplete: IsFirstHour() ? ChangeInterfaceState(IG) = main_hud : SwitchScreen(MAINMENU) = screens/frontend/ScrMainMenu. Named failures: no in-use slot in the seed (A on a disabled slot does nothing: load-slot never sees LoadComplete), or LoadComplete without a new screen. The markers replace [PATH_RESOLVE] (it cannot fire since iter-464's skip_lr: no ctx.lr on a direct call), frozen 10-24 from rolls g14A_nld / g14A_nlde and their frames. Before a roll: python tools/save_records.py verify <seed> must list a used slot. Tag the result natural, save-seeded (<label>) (docs/SAVES.md). -TimeoutSeconds 420.

steps.name: start-bootflow
steps.purpose: START -> StartBootFlow -> sign-in gate -> device step -> the C++ LoadCreate popup: its ScrGenPop request (the natural_new marker).

steps.name: popup-visible
steps.purpose: Capture window: the natural LOAD A GAME? popup with a save present.

steps.name: down-to-load
steps.purpose: Focus button 1 (Load Game); the popup's default is button 0.

steps.name: load-game
steps.purpose: LOAD GAME -> the native answer calls AS ShowSlotSelector(1): the slot picker enumerates the save device's content (0.2 s after A).

steps.name: slots-filled
steps.purpose: The adapter delivered the slot info (SetSlotWaitMode(false) follows in FillSlotInfo); only now are the slot buttons enabled and focused. Marker: the in-use slot's save image is requested, counted only after LOAD GAME was entered.

steps.name: load-slot
steps.purpose: A on the focused (first in-use) slot -> LoadTask -> LoadComplete(true), which requests the loaded game's first screen inside the same call (main_hud 57 ms after A). Absent = the seed has no in-use slot (all three disabled).

steps.name: load-lands
steps.purpose: PASS condition: the loaded game's first screen - main_hud (first hour: straight into the game) or ScrMainMenu (the METROPOLIS / FORTRESS carousel after the first hour). Not expectFresh: LoadComplete requests the screen inside the same call, so the line can land before this step starts; neither screen is requested earlier in this run.

steps.name: observe-after
steps.purpose: Capture window: whatever the loaded save shows (frames decide; ScrMainMenu needs a further A = METROPOLIS, not driven here).
